messages:
josh-support: FYI pentest reported an exposed backup object that contains audit signing keys. vendor attached ACL + presigned URL, marked as High severity. asking for triage.

maria-sec: thanks — can you paste the exact S3 path + ACL output here so infra can confirm blast radius?

josh-support: path: s3://redwood-backups/audit/key-snapshot-2026-02-05.tar.gz
ACL snippet they provided: `Grantee: AllUsers, Permission: READ`
Presigned URL (from vendor): `https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-backups/audit/key-snapshot-2026-02-05.tar.gz?X-Amz-...`

eli-pen: reproduced from our test role in ~2m. context: bucket is nightly backup target; object contains `audit_signing_key.pem` (private key) and was downloadable via presigned URL. we flagged as High because possession enables forging audit entries. evidence attached (curl + aws outputs).

maria-sec: that is concerning. infra — can you confirm whether the object actually contains the private PEM or only public certs?

dan-infra: confirmed: the tar includes `audit_signing_key.pem` (private) + `audit_signing_key.pub`. this came from legacy backup job `backup-audit-keys` that did not KMS-encrypt the payload. immediate remediation applied:
- stopped legacy job
- patched job to encrypt with CMK alias `alias/redwood/audit-sign`
- tightened bucket policy to allow only `arn:aws:iam::123456:role/backup-runner`

anna-product: any known customer impact? do we need to notify SOC/CS or customers?

josh-support: no incoming customer reports. logs show only vendor access. still prepping internal incident note.

maria-sec: for retest we need vendor to confirm 3 things: 
1) presigned URL now returns 403/404
2) `aws s3api head-object` shows `ServerSideEncryption: aws:kms` for that object
3) `get-object-acl` no longer returns public Grants
Please ask them to include raw `curl -I <url>` output and `aws` CLI snippets.

eli-pen: we can retest tomorrow 09:00 PST. we'll run the three checks and provide screenshots + CLI outputs. if we can still download, we'll escalate.

dan-infra: added change logs + rotated signing key as precaution. rotation log excerpt: 
``n2026-02-06T02:12Z backup-job: rotate-keys --rotated audit-signing -> new-kms: alias/redwood/audit-sign
``nPlease include the new KMS key ARN in evidence.

maria-sec: tagging severity: vendor called High; infra believes Medium because bucket wasn't public historically, but private PEM presence pushes integrity risk. I'm keeping severity=High until vendor confirms they can no longer retrieve private key.

eli-pen: understood. we'll attach full proof. if tests fail we'll reopen as High. if pass, we'll mark as mitigated.

josh-support: i'll hold off external comms until we have retest evidence. will post a short incident stub in #incidents once we have final results. @oncall FYI.

deploy-bot: Deploy finished: `backup-job-2026-02-06` status: success :white_check_mark:

maria-sec: thanks — @eli-pen drop the retest evidence (curl + aws outputs + key rotation ARN) here when done and we'll close the loop.

eli-pen: will do.
